text: The game begins. Seven players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra, Opus. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

name: Haiku
text: Gemma and I are both killers, so I need to keep us both alive and make the town waste its votes on innocents.

name: Haiku

name: Gemma

name: Gemma

Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.

Sol claimed to be the officer on day 1 and named Haiku as a killer, and Haiku's card later showed killer. On day 2 Opus claimed to be the doctor and said he had saved Sol on night 2, and the table voted him out anyway. Night 3 the killers got Sol, so the officer's card stayed face down. On day 3 Gemma kept pushing Terra and Sonnet without reasons, Luna kept asking her for them, and the table voted Gemma out 3 to 1. Her card showed killer, and the town won with both killers out.
